d:
Rudolf shtainar valdorf ejukeshan aur unki vivadit shikshaon se jure hain. ye dokyumentri unke vicharon ke asar ki partal karti hai aur batati hai ki ab bhi samarthak aur aalochak kyon hain.
Rudolf shtainar aaj jana-pahchana nam hain. kuchh ke lie vo durdarshi shiksha-sudharak aur manavtavadi hain. dusron ke lie vo aisi vishvadrishti ke sansthapak hain, jiska vaigyanik aadhar nahin hai. unki shikshaon ne shiksha, krishi aur chikitsa par prabhav dala aur aalochna jheli.
